people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
translations.asv: But when he was well-nigh forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
